text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
How is it, Kris S-chan?
How's that protein shake mixed with the electric shaker?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Delicious. And—there are no lumps.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: What are you guys doing?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Here's a trial of some fitness gadgets I recommend. There's also stuff like this—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! What is this?! It makes no sense at all!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Does this really have
any exercise benefits, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Tran's gadgets—
many are a mystery.
But—I want to learn—how to use them.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: You into these kinds of weird things?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
What can be useful, and how—
Sometimes, you only realize—once you come into contact with it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah! Wanna give it a try too, Espo-n and Furio?
Let's all have a gadget trial party together~♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Espo—... Say cheese.

text_block_list.name: Health Check App
text_block_list.text:
"Measurement complete! Body fat percentage and muscle mass are both superb!
A top-tier athlete! Truly magnificent~!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Just 'cause you took a pic, you think you know me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It seems they're making full use of—the latest technology.
This is—...amazing.

text_block_list.name: Health Check App
text_block_list.text: "Still, my skin's breaking out a bit and it's bothering me. Maybe I ate too much chocolate and cake?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh!? I-It's not like I even like sweet stuff at all!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Too much fat... is that it?
Instead—I recommend dried fruit.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm tellin' ya, you've got it all wrong!

text_block_list.name: Kris & Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Heh! Hah...!
...Hmph! Take that!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Oh, Kris S's blade just glinted.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-chan gets 1 point for the forearm strike~.
I'll tally the scores on my phone, so good luck, both of you~♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Furioso's swordplay—superb.
—Come at me—more.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I won't fall behind a second time.
On the pride of Funabashi—!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So, so, Chris-chan~
All those gadgets were super neat, right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. All of them are—comical, and—...some might actually prove useful.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I want to ask Tran.
Just for a bit—borrow—can I?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Trainer...—bring it on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. Recommended by Symboli Kris S,
I tried out some fitness gadgets.
After testing a few different ones—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —How was it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, this actually looks like fun!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I thought—it might be useful, too.
So—...here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reviewed the materials handed to me.
It was a training menu utilizing various gadgets.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
About what the doctor mentioned the other day—...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
She continues—to pursue it.
A Mission—to run once more in a new form.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I have thought about it too... Ways to fulfill my mission—other than running.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
For exampleâcould I not pass it on?
My own insights... just like Master did.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I am—searching for a way.
That menu was an—experiment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S strives to revolutionize Japanese racing
in every way possible.
Seeing her like that fills me with confidence.
choice_data_list: Shall we fine-tune this routine a bit more?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...! 
Thanks—that was very enlightening.
